name: Accounts – Improved
body:
Some accountants are better than others. However, they are more discriminating and will not see just anyone.

Prerequisite:

Accounts, in possession of at least 10,000 GP

Benefit:

Same as Accounts, except the bonus they provide to their clients is:

Tax reduction: 2d10 + 20 %

Tax back once a year: 2d10 x 200

Special:

20% of any income saved or gained goes to the accountant as fees. This comes out of the clients’ share of the money
